span.p: Reads charged to the decision's evaluation.regex-max-reads-per-decision and to the request's evaluation.regex-max-reads-per-request

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: true or false; evaluation continues with the next cell or row
